fields.Name: T123 - AI Analytics Time Range Chips
fields.Description: Tests the mj-filter-chip time-range control (OnTimeRangeChange re-querying the active analytics section) - a distinct interactive filter mechanism from the popover filters and section nav.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Analytics section (stay on a data section such as Prompt Runs or Executive Summary). Locate the time-range chips in the section toolbar (e.g. 24h / 7d / 30d / 90d). Click a different time-range chip than the currently active one. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away. Success is that the clicked chip becomes the active/selected one and the analytics content reloads/responds to the new range (charts or metrics refresh), or a valid empty state appears for that range.

judgeValidationCriteria: A row of time-range chips is visible and one is marked active
Clicking a different chip moves the active state to it and the content area refreshes/responds to the new time range (or shows a valid empty state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
